### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/driver-sql`, `@objectstack/driver-turso`, touching **21** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cloud-connection/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**10** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/index.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin (symbol, a top-level class), needs_confirm (literal, a string literal in isInstallRelaxation), relax_not_null (literal, a string literal in isInstallRelaxation))_
- `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/index.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/lifecycle.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class), needs_confirm (literal, a string literal in isInstallRelaxation))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-1.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cloud-connection/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **20** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 12a0f09fca49bf90747e9cea21d566229c33de70` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `742593aa121cc77d91d9b879dd322cd12a0bdfa0` — the merge of head `b99495bed5d07f92713a0ffe411b26dca7c5745b` into base `12a0f09fca49bf90747e9cea21d566229c33de70`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 742593aa121cc77d91d9b879dd322cd12a0bdfa0 && git checkout 742593aa121cc77d91d9b879dd322cd12a0bdfa0
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 12a0f09fca49bf90747e9cea21d566229c33de70 b99495bed5d07f92713a0ffe411b26dca7c5745b && git checkout -B drift-repro 12a0f09fca49bf90747e9cea21d566229c33de70 && git merge --no-ff b99495bed5d07f92713a0ffe411b26dca7c5745b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 12a0f09fca49bf90747e9cea21d566229c33de70
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 12a0f09fca49bf90747e9cea21d566229c33de70` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Review — FAIL

Head-sha: `9ef79bb80ab7e18c6a8c26d5de504e2251f2d4cc`

review (review-b, areas S2+S4) · read at 2026-11-15T10:05Z · diff read against GitHub at this head (merge-base `346d56d4`, 12 files, +676/−4), not from the report.

### Must-fix

1. **`Clause-②: no` is wrong for this diff.** It enlarges the published surface of two released packages (`private` unset, `exports: { ".": … }`):
   - new root exports of `@objectstack/cloud-connection`: `relaxInstallDeclaredNotNull`, `declaredNullableColumns` and the types `InstallRelaxDriver`, `InstallRelaxEngine`, `InstallRelaxEntry`, `InstallRelaxReport` (`packages/cloud-connection/src/index.ts`);
   - a new public method `SqlDriver.relaxDeclaredNotNull` on the exported class (`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts`).

   The criterion is "does it widen the accept set or enlarge the public surface", and it does. The two direct precedents declared it that way: #32848 (`SqlDriver.applyPublishedColumnChanges`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`) and #31929 (one new root export of `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`).
   Fix: the seat re-states the claim's line (the queue gate reads the claim comment's line-initial key), and the PR body and the changeset both read `Clause-②: yes (widening) — <the new exports and the driver method>`. `Metadata-protocol: none` and the `patch` level stay as they are. The new head then owes a `TIER_DEFAULT` contract-review record; this review seat writes it on the delta.

### Should-fix (fold into this PR, ≤30 lines)

2. **The lenient-path guard has no pin.** Nothing reds if `if (hotLoadError === undefined)` in step 4b″ is removed: none of ablations A1–A6 touches it, and no test covers a hot-register that fails leniently (a cloud install, register throwing with no 4xx). Add one case: lenient register failure → the column stays NOT NULL. Ablate the guard and quote the red.

### Nit

3. `InstallRelaxReport.unsupported` is computed and exported, but the door never logs it. An object whose declared relax lands on a driver without the door is silent. Add one `warn` line in `relaxDeclaredNotNull`, or drop the field.

### Checked and holds

- **Premise.** Measured on the card on 18.4.0: the drift warning, `notnull=1`, the 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` on the publish, and `migrate apply` working locally only.
- **Scope.**
  - The relax is only `relax_not_null`, `needs_confirm`, on a named column whose SERVED field also says `storage.notNull === false`, with `allowDestructive: false`. A customization that re-declares `true` is therefore not relaxed.
  - Only the installing package's own objects and `objectExtensions` fields are named, and federated objects are skipped.
  - The boot, rehydrate and `reconcileAndWarnDrift` are untouched, and `deferredDdl` short-circuits.
  - The 409 schema-upgrade verdict (#30884) confirms renames and type changes only. Leaving a lossless relax outside it is consistent with that verdict.
- **ADR-0113 D5.** I read the managed install as the deliberate act for a sealed package object, parallel to the publish for an environment-authored one. I find that sound: it is lossless, covers only the package's own words, and auto-applies nothing at boot. A one-line D5 amendment naming the install is governed text (Tier H), so it is left out of this PR. It is owed to the seat as a follow-up card.
- **File surface.** Driver-sql schema sync and the install seam are as named in claim 6892068816. The turso `REMOTE_FACE_ANSWERS` row is the one-line conformance answer a new `SqlDriver` method requires, recorded as seat-approved in the body.
- **Card relation.** `Part of #33724` is correct, since the hosted control-plane half is `carrier: cloud`. No closing keyword sits next to an open card number.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/33724-install-relaxes-declared-not-null.md` is `patch` for the three touched published packages. I checked each sentence against the diff and they hold. Its `Clause-②:` line follows item 1.
- **Pins and ablations.** The pins assert the column's nullability and a create without the field, not just a 200 status. A1–A6 are reported with restored blobs and an empty `git diff HEAD`, and A6 runs through the built dist. I did not re-run them.
- **Not measured.** The MySQL cell was not measured locally, and `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` is skipped on this PR. The MySQL relax goes through the existing `applyMigrationEntries` path that `os migrate apply` already uses.
- **Check-runs at this head.** 48 runs, of which 15 had not finished (Build Core, Test Core 1–8/8, Type Check · workspace, consumer gates and debt ledger, two Lint jobs, Live E2E UI), and none failed. I re-read the check-runs on the next head.
- **Author.** `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay write).
- SQL push-down: not applicable.

The review is owed by the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line alone: there is no `packages/spec/src/**` and no governed path in the committed tree. I read the full diff at `9ef79bb8` (verdict 6892748650) and the delta `9ef79bb8..b99495be` (1 commit, 4 files, +60/−7), both against GitHub.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Declaration.** Restated claim 6892758801 carries the line-initial `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. The PR body and `.changeset/33724-install-relaxes-declared-not-null.md` carry the same line plus the list of what widens. That list matches the diff:
  - `@objectstack/cloud-connection` root exports `relaxInstallDeclaredNotNull`, `declaredNullableColumns`, `InstallRelaxDriver`, `InstallRelaxEngine`, `InstallRelaxEntry` and `InstallRelaxReport` (`src/index.ts`);
  - the public `SqlDriver.relaxDeclaredNotNull` (`driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts`).
- **Nothing is narrowed.** No existing export, signature or accepted value changes:
  - `contributionsOf` gains `export` inside its module only. It is not re-exported from the root.
  - The `schema-drift.ts` change is message text plus a comment.
  - The turso change is one `REMOTE_FACE_ANSWERS` row, `inherited`.
- **Metadata-protocol: none is correct.** No authorable key, value or metadata type changes.
- **Precedents agree.** #32848 (`SqlDriver.applyPublishedColumnChanges`) and #31929 (one new cloud-connection root export) both declared `yes (widening)` with `none`.

### ② Semver level

- `patch` on `@objectstack/driver-sql`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection` and `@objectstack/driver-turso` is correct. AGENTS.md says a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`, and `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`.
- The change is not breaking, so no ADR-0087 marker is owed. `Check Changeset` is `success` on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Security and permission boundary.** None crossed. The relax runs inside the existing managed install door, after its own auth and confirmations, and alters only lossless nullability.
- **Scope of the relax:**
  - it touches only columns the INSTALLING package's own body declares `storage: { notNull: false }`;
  - the SERVED field must also say `false`;
  - federated objects are skipped;
  - `allowDestructive: false` holds;
  - a boot or rehydrate never calls it, and the lenient path is now pinned (A7 reported red, 1 of 7, restored).
- **ADR-0113 D5.** The managed install is read as the deliberate act for a sealed package object. The D5 sentence naming the install is governed text, so it is owed to the seat as a follow-up card and is not edited here.
- **SQL push-down.** No id materialisation or in-app join is added.
- **Author.** PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay write).

## Review — PASS

Head-sha: `b99495bed5d07f92713a0ffe411b26dca7c5745b`

review (review-b, areas S2+S4) · 2026-11-15T10:18Z · delta review of `9ef79bb8..b99495be` (1 commit: `fix(cloud-connection): pin the lenient install path and log drivers without the relax door`), against FAIL 6892748650.

1. **Clause-② (was must-fix): fixed.**
   - Claim 6892758801 restates `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
   - The PR body and the changeset carry the same line, with the list of what widens.
   - `Metadata-protocol: none` and `patch` are unchanged.
   - The `TIER_DEFAULT` contract-review record is 6892876561: PASS at this head.
2. **Lenient-path pin (was should-fix): fixed.**
   - The new case mounts the door with a cloud control-plane URL and serves the v2 snapshot through a stubbed `fetch`, with the public fast-path off and a service key stubbed.
   - The register writes v2's objects and then throws an undeclared error. The install answers 200 with `hotLoaded: false` and `hotLoadError` set.
   - Positive control: the served field really says `notNull: false`. The column stays NOT NULL, and a create without the field is refused.
   - A7 (guard → `if (true)`) is reported red, 1 of 7, and restored.
   - The new `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` and `vi.unstubAllEnvs()` in `afterEach` keep the stubs from leaking into the other cases.
3. **`unsupported` not logged (was nit): fixed.**
   - One `warn` per unsupported object names its declared columns and the `os migrate apply` remedy.
   - It is asserted in the no-relax-door case, and A8 is reported red, 1 of 7, and restored.
   - The `InstallRelaxReport.unsupported` doc no longer says federated objects are listed (they are skipped), which matches the code.

**Not changed by the delta:** driver-sql and driver-turso (as at `d248309b`); the rest of the earlier review stands.

**Check-runs at this head (read at review time):**
- `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Check PR Size`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` and `filter` are `success`.
- Build Core, Test Core, the Type Check jobs, Lint · ESLint, the other Lint jobs and Live E2E UI were still running. None had failed.
- This PASS does not stand in for them: landing waits for every check on this head to be green or an expected skip.

**Follow-ups, not part of this PR:**
- a governed card for the one-line ADR-0113 D5 amendment naming the managed install as the deliberate relax for a sealed package object (seat);
- the hosted control-plane install door (`carrier: cloud`), which stays open on #33724.
